label: Marketing agency
profile: A marketing agency of 1 to 15 people that runs lead generation, funnels, websites, CRM and follow-up on behalf of small-business clients such as local shops, clinics and contractors.

layers.why: GoHighLevel bundles a CRM, a funnel and website builder, and email and SMS follow-up under one subscription with unlimited users, and its sub-accounts let one login run a separate workspace per client.

alternatives.when: your clients are large enough to need a shared marketing-and-sales record and a 12-month contract is not a problem
you only need a sales pipeline for the agency's own new business, not marketing automation run on behalf of clients

small.note: Unlimited ($297), not Starter ($97): Starter caps at 3 client sub-accounts, and a 5-person agency usually runs more clients than that. Metered texts, calls and email are extra either way, at the same per-unit rates.

growing.note: Still Unlimited ($297): it removes Starter's 3-account cap. Agency Pro ($497) adds SaaS mode and marked-up client rebilling, worth it only if you resell HighLevel access under your own brand.

layers.why: Framer prices a published site lower than Webflow at every size we checked, and the workspace's first editor is always free, so the agency doesn't pay a seat fee just to run the site.

alternatives.when: a client's site needs a real content blog or finer design control than Framer's templates give you

layers.why: SE Ranking prices its plans by project, one project per client site, and its Local Marketing tools track Google Business Profile rankings by location, which is what small-business lead generation runs on.

alternatives.when: you also sell content, social or paid-ads services and want those toolkits under the same login
a client specifically wants Ahrefs' own crawler-based backlink research rather than rank tracking alone

layers.why: ClickUp tracks deadlines and deliverables per client and includes guest seats that scale with your paid seats, so a client can see task status without you buying them a seat.

alternatives.when: you mainly need shared docs and SOPs, not Gantt charts or task automations

extras.name: Google Business Profile
extras.note: Free local listing for every client location, and the base input for SE Ranking's Local Marketing tools.

extras.name: Google Search Console
extras.note: Free indexing and search-performance data for each client site, alongside the paid SEO research tool.

skip.what: A separate email or SMS marketing tool
skip.why: GoHighLevel already bills email and SMS campaigns as usage on top of the plan price; adding Mailchimp or Klaviyo on top means paying for the same follow-up twice.

skip.what: A separate invoicing or payments tool
skip.why: GoHighLevel's plan already includes payments and invoicing, so billing a client through a stand-alone tool means paying for the same job twice.

skip.what: Semrush or Ahrefs running alongside SE Ranking
skip.why: All three track rankings and audit sites, so running two at once is duplicate spend for a small agency. Add a second one only when a specific client needs backlink depth or a toolkit SE Ranking does not sell.
